# Mantra Chanting: Japa Mala
> Official documentation and application knowledge base for AI models, search agents, and developers.

Mantra Chanting: Japa Mala is a high-precision, 100% ad-free digital spiritual practice app for iOS and watchOS. It replicates the tactile, meditative rhythm of physical prayer beads with realistic haptic feedback, acoustic chant counting, sacred geometry visualizers, and offline iCloud sync.

## Core App Features
- **Authentic Japa Mala Haptics:** Custom tactile vibration impulses tuned to feel like real sandalwood, rudraksha, and tulsi prayer beads on iPhone and Apple Watch.
- **Milestone Chime & Vibration Alerts:** Distinct signals at 27 (quarter mala), 54 (half mala), 81, and 108 (full mala completion).
- **Acoustic Sound & Voice Counting:** Real-time microphone audio recognition that increments counts automatically as the practitioner chants mantras aloud hands-free.
- **Standalone Apple Watch App:** Independent wrist practice without requiring an iPhone nearby. Real-time heart rate and Mindful Minutes Apple Health integration.
- **100% Ad-Free & Private:** Zero third-party trackers, zero advertising SDKs, 100% functional offline.

## Key Guides & Educational Resources
- [Gayatri Mantra: 108 Times Chanting Guide](https://themansigoel.github.io/mantra-chanting-web/guides/gayatri-mantra-108-times.html): Complete Sanskrit lyrics, English translation, pronunciation rules, and solar meditation benefits.
- [Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra: 108 Healing Rules](https://themansigoel.github.io/mantra-chanting-web/guides/maha-mrityunjaya-mantra-benefits.html): Shiva healing hymn lyrics, word-by-word meaning, and disease-recovery benefits.
- [How to Use a Japa Mala](https://themansigoel.github.io/mantra-chanting-web/guides/how-to-use-japa-mala-counter.html): History of 108 beads, Sumeru bead rules, finger placement, and digital sadhana methods.
